state.contract: Pure Conway Life in Bend 2.0.29. Public operations: step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>; evolve(turns: Nat, width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>. Reusable parameter annotations may vary as required by the checker. Valid dimensions are 0..32 inclusive; cells contains exactly width*height binary values in row-major order. The exterior is permanently dead, with no wrapping. Each synchronous step counts the eight OLD-board neighbors excluding the center: birth at three, survival at two or three, otherwise death. Return the complete ordered board, preserving binary range, exact shape and reusable input. evolve(0,w,h,c)=c; evolve performs exactly turns steps; evolving a then b agrees with a+b; empty boards remain empty. Finite behavioral gates exercise turns 0..8 but are not a universal proof. Invalid shapes, nonbinary inputs and dimensions outside the domain are unspecified. Only Base is imported; no foreign code, IO, holes, unsafe annotations, new axioms or fixture-specific behavior. No speed, GPU or universal correctness claim is established by this style review.

import Base

# Column x occupies bit x; unpacking clips to width and threads a suffix.
def row.emit(width: Nat, +bits: U32, tail: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      tail
    case 1n+p:
      (bits .&. 1 : U32) <> row.emit(p, U32.shr(bits), tail)

# The continuation receives one packed row and the untouched cell suffix.
def row.read(width: Nat, cells: List<&2,U32>, emit: U32 -> List<&2,U32> -> List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      emit(0, cells)
    case 1n+p:
      match cells:
        case Nil{}:
          emit(0, Nil{})
        case bit <> tail:
          row.read(p, tail, bits => rest => emit((bit .|. U32.shl(bits) : U32), rest))

# v0 + 2*v1 counts vertically; w/e shift those planes one column.
# The center is included: three lives, four keeps its old center.
def row.step(+north: U32, +here: U32, +south: U32) -> U32:
  +ns = (north .^. south : U32)
  +v0 = (ns .^. here : U32)
  +v1 = ((north .&. south : U32) .|. (ns .&. here : U32) : U32)
  +w0 = U32.shl(v0)
  +e0 = U32.shr(v0)
  +w1 = U32.shl(v1)
  +e1 = U32.shr(v1)
  +one = (w0 .^. v0 .^. e0 : U32)
  +lo = ((w0 .&. v0 : U32) .|. (e0 .&. (w0 .|. v0 : U32) : U32) : U32)
  +hi = (w1 .^. v1 .^. e1 : U32)
  carry = ((w1 .&. v1 : U32) .|. (e1 .&. (w1 .|. v1 : U32) : U32) : U32)
  +two = (lo .^. hi : U32)
  +four = (carry .^. (lo .&. hi : U32) : U32)
  three = (one .&. two .&. U32.not(four) : U32)
  four = (U32.not((one .|. two : U32)) .&. four : U32)
  (three .|. (here .&. four : U32) : U32)

# Read old below, emit new here, then advance the old-row window.
def rows.sweep(height: Nat, +width: Nat, above: U32, +here: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      row.emit(width, row.step(above, here, 0), Nil{})
    case 1n+p:
      row.read(width, cells, +below => rest =>
        row.emit(width, row.step(above, here, below), rows.sweep(p, width, here, below, rest)))

def rows.step(height: Nat, +width: Nat, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+p:
      row.read(width, cells, here => rest => rows.sweep(p, width, 0, here, rest))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  rows.step(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells)

def evolve(turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+p:
      evolve(p, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
